courses.title: 矽晶圓線鋸切片
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解切縫、TTV、次表面損傷，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore kerf, ttv and subsurface damage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 晶棒與切片預算
stages.description: 在「晶棒與切片預算」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for ingot and slicing budget, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 辨識晶向
steps.objective: 完成「辨識晶向」的因果圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify crystal orientation, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：辨識晶向。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify crystal orientation. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨識晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify crystal orientation and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「辨識晶向」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for identify crystal orientation: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 辨識晶向的原理
knowledge.text: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。
knowledge.textEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.

quiz.question: 評估「辨識晶向」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating identify crystal orientation?
options: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。
TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。
只量中心厚度即可代表全片形貌。
optionsEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance.
TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable.
Center thickness alone represents full-wafer geometry.
quiz.explanation: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
quiz.explanationEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.

steps.title: 定義可用晶棒長
steps.objective: 完成「定義可用晶棒長」的對照表，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for define usable ingot length, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：定義可用晶棒長。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：頭尾排除長度會改變可用片數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define usable ingot length. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Head and tail exclusions change usable wafer count. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頭尾排除長度會改變可用片數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Head and tail exclusions change usable wafer count. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「定義可用晶棒長」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define usable ingot length and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「定義可用晶棒長」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for define usable ingot length: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 切縫預算
steps.objective: 完成「切縫預算」的敏感度草圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for budget kerf, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：切縫預算。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：每片占用長度包含晶圓厚度與切縫。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂算例：可用晶棒長 100 mm、切片厚 0.8 mm、切縫 0.2 mm；先求理想片數，再將切縫改為 0.25 mm 比較整數片數，列出尚未納入的端損與不良片。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget kerf. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Length consumed per slice includes wafer thickness and kerf. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical exercise: usable ingot length 100 mm, slice thickness 0.8 mm and kerf 0.2 mm. Calculate ideal integer count, change kerf to 0.25 mm and list excluded end losses and rejects.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「每片占用長度包含晶圓厚度與切縫。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget kerf and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「切縫預算」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for budget kerf: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.title: 厚度留量
steps.objective: 完成「厚度留量」的故障判別表，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for reserve thickness allowance, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：厚度留量。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：切片厚度還須支付損傷移除與拋光留量。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Reserve thickness allowance. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Sliced thickness must cover damage removal and polishing allowance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「切片厚度還須支付損傷移除與拋光留量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「厚度留量」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for reserve thickness allowance: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：固定端受力圖。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：偏心固定會讓進給負荷在切片中不均。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw mounting loads. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Eccentric mounting makes feed loading asymmetric. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「偏心固定會讓進給負荷在切片中不均。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for draw mounting loads: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：來料電阻率分區。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：沿晶棒的電阻率變化不能用單片平均值代表。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map incoming resistivity. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: One wafer average cannot describe axial resistivity variation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for map incoming resistivity: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate wire diameter and pitch. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Wire diameter, kerf and guide-groove pitch differ. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「線徑、切縫與導輪槽距是不同幾何量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Wire diameter, kerf and guide-groove pitch differ. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：晶圓表面外觀平整就可排除次表面裂紋。 應回到「線徑與槽距」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: A flat-looking surface rules out subsurface cracks. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate wire diameter and pitch and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「線徑與槽距」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate wire diameter and pitch: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

quiz.explanationEn: More slices may not improve usable silicon yield if rejects increase. A smaller kerf may not improve overall silicon utilization if it requires more downstream damage removal.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Track wire consumption. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Wire consumption should be normalized by accepted wafers. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「線耗量需按合格片數正規化。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for track wire consumption: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

courses.title: 矽磊晶層生長
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 基板與磊晶目標
stages.description: 在「基板與磊晶目標」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for substrate and epitaxy target, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：區分磊晶與沉積。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：磊晶需要與基板有確定晶體關係。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Distinguish epitaxy from deposition. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Epitaxy requires a defined crystallographic relationship to the substrate. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「磊晶需要與基板有確定晶體關係。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Epitaxy requires a defined crystallographic relationship to the substrate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「區分磊晶與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for distinguish epitaxy from deposition and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「區分磊晶與沉積」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for distinguish epitaxy from deposition: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 區分磊晶與沉積的原理
knowledge.text: 磊晶需要與基板有確定晶體關係。
knowledge.textEn: Epitaxy requires a defined crystallographic relationship to the substrate.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 基板提供晶格模板，但摻雜、殘留氧化物與缺陷會改變新生晶層的電性與完整性。
knowledge.textEn: The substrate provides lattice registry, but doping, oxide and defects affect the new layer’s electrical and structural quality.

quiz.question: 評估「區分磊晶與沉積」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating distinguish epitaxy from deposition?
options: 磊晶需要與基板有確定晶體關係。
TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。
只量中心厚度即可代表全片形貌。
optionsEn: Epitaxy requires a defined crystallographic relationship to the substrate.
TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable.

courses.title: 絕緣層上覆矽晶圓製造
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解頂矽均勻性、埋氧、鍵合空洞，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for soi layer functions, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify the three-layer stack. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Top silicon, buried oxide and handle wafer have different roles. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頂矽、埋氧與支撐晶圓分別承擔不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify the three-layer stack and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「辨認三層結構」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for budget top-silicon thickness, connecting relevant limits in top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：頂矽厚度預算。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：分裂後修整會消耗頂矽留量。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂厚度帳：頂矽轉移後 120 個任意厚度單位、修整消耗 15、後續氧化消耗矽 5；求剩餘量，再檢查是否有把氧化物厚度誤當成矽消耗。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget top-silicon thickness. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Post-split finishing consumes top-silicon allowance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical thickness ledger: transferred top silicon 120 arbitrary units, finishing consumes 15 and later oxidation consumes 5 silicon units. Compute the remainder and check that oxide thickness was not confused with silicon consumption.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「分裂後修整會消耗頂矽留量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Post-split finishing consumes top-silicon allowance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「頂矽厚度預算」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget top-silicon thickness and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「頂矽厚度預算」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for budget top-silicon thickness: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.check: 交付「離子層深度」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

steps.check: 交付「頂矽厚度圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

courses.title: 晶圓表面清洗
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解去污效果、材料損失、再污染，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore removal, material loss and recontamination through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 污染與表面目標
stages.description: 在「污染與表面目標」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for contaminants and surface targets, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 污染分類

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for classify contaminants, connecting relevant limits in removal, material loss and recontamination to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：污染分類。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Classify contaminants. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「污染分類」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify contaminants and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「污染分類」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for classify contaminants: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.text: 去除目標可能是表面粒子、溶解金屬或反應殘留；同一粒子掃描器不能提供這三者完整證據。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Build substrate compatibility tables. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: A contaminant-removing treatment may also attack functional films. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「前後粒子差」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for calculate particle adders: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：潔淨交接單。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Complete the cleanliness handoff. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低壓差證明濾芯不存在任何旁通。 應回到「潔淨交接單」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low pressure drop proves no filtration bypass exists. Revisit assumptions and sampling for complete the cleanliness handoff and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「潔淨交接單」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for complete the cleanliness handoff: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 潔淨交接單的原理
knowledge.text: 移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。
knowledge.textEn: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 清潔驗收要比較污染減少與基底消耗，並確認搬運及排隊後的表面仍符合下一模組要求。
knowledge.textEn: Cleaning acceptance balances contaminant removal against substrate consumption and verifies the surface after transport and queueing.

quiz.question: 評估「潔淨交接單」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。
optionsEn: Low pressure drop proves no filtration bypass exists.
Queue time after cleaning cannot affect recontamination.
Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff.
quiz.explanation: 移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。 清潔驗收要比較污染減少與基底消耗，並確認搬運及排隊後的表面仍符合下一模組要求。
quiz.explanationEn: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff. Cleaning acceptance balances contaminant removal against substrate consumption and verifies the surface after transport and queueing.

courses.title: 超純水供應系統
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解水質多指標、使用點、滯留，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 用水需求與污染
stages.description: 在「用水需求與污染」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for water demand and contaminants, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 界定使用點
steps.objective: 完成「界定使用點」的因果圖，把水質多指標、使用點、滯留中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define points of use, connecting relevant limits in water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：界定使用點。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define points of use. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「界定使用點」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define points of use and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「界定使用點」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define points of use: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 界定使用點的原理
knowledge.text: 沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。
knowledge.textEn: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 污染物質量流率為濃度乘流量；濃度相同時，大流量使用點可能接收更大的污染總量。
knowledge.textEn: Contaminant mass flow is concentration times flow, so a high-flow outlet can receive more contaminant at equal concentration.

quiz.question: 評估「界定使用點」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define points of use?
options: 沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。
粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。
未檢出代表污染濃度精確為零。
optionsEn: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality.
Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration.
Nondetection means exactly zero contamination.
quiz.explanation: 沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。 污染物質量流率為濃度乘流量；濃度相同時，大流量使用點可能接收更大的污染總量。
quiz.explanationEn: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality. Contaminant mass flow is concentration times flow, so a high-flow outlet can receive more contaminant at equal concentration.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate peak and average flow. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Average demand misses coincident usage peaks. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「峰值與平均流量」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for separate peak and average flow: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Concentration and flow jointly determine contaminant flux. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify resistivity blind spots. Interpretation: High resistivity does not exclude neutral organics or particles. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

courses.title: 晶圓廠微污染控制
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore sources, transport and defect maps through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for sources and pathways, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map contamination sources: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating map contamination sources?

未檢出代表污染濃度精確為零。

Nondetection means exactly zero contamination.

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for separate size and hazard: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

Interpretation: Particle filtration does not establish molecular-contamination control. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for distinguish particles and molecules: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：暴露劑量。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：表面負荷同時取決於濃度與暴露時間。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂暴露模型：先假設沉積通量與濃度成正比。案例甲濃度 2、時間 3，案例乙濃度 1、時間 8；比較相對暴露，再列使此線性模型失效的吸附飽和情況。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Estimate contamination exposure. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Surface burden depends on concentration and exposure duration. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical exposure model: deposition flux is proportional to concentration. Compare relative exposures for concentration/time pairs (2,3) and (1,8), then state how adsorption saturation could invalidate linearity.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「表面負荷同時取決於濃度與暴露時間。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「暴露劑量」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for estimate contamination exposure: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

courses.title: 晶圓廠自動搬運系統
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 搬運圖與產能
stages.description: 在「搬運圖與產能」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for transport graph and capacity, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 辨識載具與批號

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify carriers and lots, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：辨識載具與批號。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify carriers and lots. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「辨識載具與批號」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify carriers and lots and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「辨識載具與批號」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for identify carriers and lots: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 辨識載具與批號的原理

knowledge.textEn: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。
knowledge.textEn: Wafers revisit equipment types, making transport a reentrant network problem rather than one-way line-distance minimization.

quiz.question: 評估「辨識載具與批號」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating identify carriers and lots?

optionsEn: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields.
Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task.
Handshake timeout means the carrier has not moved.
quiz.explanation: 載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。
quiz.explanationEn: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. Wafers revisit equipment types, making transport a reentrant network problem rather than one-way line-distance minimization.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Build the directed route graph. steps.check: 交付「建立有向路網」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。

courses.title: 熱氧化閘極介電層
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 界面與氧化目的
stages.description: 在「界面與氧化目的」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for interface and oxidation purpose, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 分辨成長與沉積

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate growth and deposition, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：分辨成長與沉積。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate growth and deposition. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「分辨成長與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate growth and deposition and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「分辨成長與沉積」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate growth and deposition: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.text: 熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。

knowledge.text: 熱氧化形成的氧化物同時向原表面上下延伸；截面預算需分開記錄矽消耗與外部厚度增加。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal oxide extends above and below the original surface; separate silicon consumption from outward thickness increase.

quiz.question: 評估「分辨成長與沉積」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。 熱氧化形成的氧化物同時向原表面上下延伸；截面預算需分開記錄矽消耗與外部厚度增加。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：界面位置移動。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：氧化後原表面不等於新的矽氧界面位置。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂幾何模型：假設氧化物厚度 100 個單位、矽消耗為其 0.44 倍；以原表面為零畫出新界面與外表面。0.44 是近似體積換算，非本課量測值。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Track the moving interface. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: The original surface differs from the final silicon-oxide interface. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical geometry: oxide thickness 100 units and silicon consumption 0.44 times that thickness. Mark the new interface and outer surface relative to the original surface. The 0.44 is an approximate volume conversion, not course measurement data.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「氧化後原表面不等於新的矽氧界面位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for track the moving interface and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「界面位置移動」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for track the moving interface: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.title: 閘氧與場氧
steps.objective: 完成「閘氧與場氧」的敏感度草圖，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：閘氧與場氧。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：電容控制與區域隔離使用不同設計目標。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。

knowledge.textEn: Oxidation consumes thermal budget and alters dopant profiles, so an acceptable oxide can coexist with degraded junction or short-channel behavior.

quiz.question: 評估「氮化選項」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating evaluate nitridation tradeoffs?
options: 介面工程必須同時評估漏電、陷阱與遷移率。
低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。
較快成長永遠改善圖案選擇性。
optionsEn: Interface engineering must consider leakage, traps and mobility together.
Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance.
Faster growth always improves pattern selectivity.
quiz.explanation: 介面工程必須同時評估漏電、陷阱與遷移率。 氧化也消耗熱預算並改變摻雜輪廓，因此合格氧化層仍可能造成鄰近接面或短通道指標變差。
quiz.explanationEn: Interface engineering must consider leakage, traps and mobility together. Oxidation consumes thermal budget and alters dopant profiles, so an acceptable oxide can coexist with degraded junction or short-channel behavior.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: State model limits. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Classical thick-film models cannot be unconditionally extrapolated to ultrathin interfaces. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「經典厚膜模型不能無條件外推到極薄介面。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Classical thick-film models cannot be unconditionally extrapolated to ultrathin interfaces. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「模型失效界線」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for state model limits and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「模型失效界線」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for state model limits: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

courses.title: 高介電常數原子層沉積
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 介電層與電容
stages.description: 在「介電層與電容」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for dielectric and capacitance, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 物理厚度與 EOT
steps.objective: 完成「物理厚度與 EOT」的因果圖，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate thickness and eot, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：物理厚度與 EOT。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate thickness and EOT. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「物理厚度與 EOT」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate thickness and eot and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「物理厚度與 EOT」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate thickness and eot: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 物理厚度與 EOT的原理
knowledge.text: 較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。
knowledge.textEn: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 串聯介電層滿足電容倒數相加；若介面層電容較小，單純提高上層介電常數的整體收益有限。
knowledge.textEn: Series capacitances add inversely; a small interfacial capacitance limits benefits from raising the upper-layer permittivity.

quiz.question: 評估「物理厚度與 EOT」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate thickness and eot?
options: 較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。 串聯介電層滿足電容倒數相加；若介面層電容較小，單純提高上層介電常數的整體收益有限。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. Series capacitances add inversely; a small interfacial capacitance limits benefits from raising the upper-layer permittivity.

steps.title: 串聯介面電容
steps.objective: 完成「串聯介面電容」的對照表，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for calculate series interface capacitance, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：串聯介面電容。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：薄介面層仍可能主導整體等效氧化厚度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂電容模型：令介面與上層電容分別為 2 與 8 個單位；算串聯總電容，再將上層增為 16。比較收益並說明瓶頸。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Calculate series interface capacitance. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: A thin interfacial layer can dominate equivalent oxide thickness. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical capacitance model: interface and upper-layer capacitances are 2 and 8 units. Calculate series capacitance, increase the upper layer to 16 and identify the limiting contribution.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「薄介面層仍可能主導整體等效氧化厚度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A thin interfacial layer can dominate equivalent oxide thickness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「串聯介面電容」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for calculate series interface capacitance and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「串聯介面電容」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for calculate series interface capacitance: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Surface functional groups affect precursor adsorption and nucleation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：前驅物相容性。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：揮發性、穩定性及殘留物需一起考慮。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。

steps.title: 介面偶極
steps.objective: 完成「介面偶極」的因果圖，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：介面偶極。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：介面化學可能同時改變有效功函數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace interface dipoles. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Interface chemistry can also change effective work function. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「介面化學可能同時改變有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace interface dipoles and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「介面偶極」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 低 EOT、低漏電及低陷阱密度是不同目標；改變介面處理可能改善其中一項卻犧牲另一項。
knowledge.textEn: Low EOT, leakage and trap density are distinct objectives; an interface treatment may improve one while compromising another.

quiz.question: 評估「介面偶極」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating trace interface dipoles?

較快成長永遠改善圖案選擇性。
optionsEn: Interface chemistry can also change effective work function.
Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance.
Faster growth always improves pattern selectivity.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：遷移率代價。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：高電容增益需與散射及陷阱造成的劣化比較。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess mobility tradeoffs. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「高電容增益需與散射及陷阱造成的劣化比較。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess mobility tradeoffs: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

quiz.question: 評估「配方變更見證」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

steps.title: 高介電層放行
steps.objective: 完成「高介電層放行」的工程驗收單，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for release the high-k layer, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：高介電層放行。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：EOT、漏電、陷阱及三維覆蓋應共同審查。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Release the high-k layer. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Review EOT, leakage, traps and 3D coverage jointly. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「EOT、漏電、陷阱及三維覆蓋應共同審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Review EOT, leakage, traps and 3D coverage jointly. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「高介電層放行」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for release the high-k layer and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「高介電層放行」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for release the high-k layer: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

courses.title: 金屬閘極功函數工程
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 能帶與閘極
stages.description: 在「能帶與閘極」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for band alignment and gates, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 定義真空功函數
steps.objective: 完成「定義真空功函數」的因果圖，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define vacuum work function, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：定義真空功函數。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define vacuum work function. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「定義真空功函數」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define vacuum work function and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「定義真空功函數」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define vacuum work function: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 定義真空功函數的原理
knowledge.text: 金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。
knowledge.textEn: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 平帶及閾值由金屬、介電層、半導體與電荷共同決定，不能用單一金屬真空功函數直接替代整個堆疊。
knowledge.textEn: Flat-band and threshold depend on metal, dielectric, semiconductor and charge; vacuum work function cannot replace the whole stack.

quiz.question: 評估「定義真空功函數」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define vacuum work function?
options: 金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。 平帶及閾值由金屬、介電層、半導體與電荷共同決定，不能用單一金屬真空功函數直接替代整個堆疊。
quiz.explanationEn: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. Flat-band and threshold depend on metal, dielectric, semiconductor and charge; vacuum work function cannot replace the whole stack.

steps.title: 平帶條件
steps.objective: 完成「平帶條件」的對照表，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for draw flat-band conditions, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：平帶條件。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：平帶電壓也受介面電荷影響。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw flat-band conditions. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Flat-band voltage is also affected by interface charge. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「平帶電壓也受介面電荷影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Flat-band voltage is also affected by interface charge. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「平帶條件」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw flat-band conditions and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「平帶條件」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for draw flat-band conditions: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: NMOS 與 PMOS
steps.objective: 完成「NMOS 與 PMOS」的敏感度草圖，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for separate nmos and pmos targets, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：NMOS 與 PMOS。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：互補元件需要不同閾值設定策略。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate NMOS and PMOS targets. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Complementary devices need different threshold-setting strategies. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「互補元件需要不同閾值設定策略。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Complementary devices need different threshold-setting strategies. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「NMOS 與 PMOS」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate nmos and pmos targets and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「NMOS 與 PMOS」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for separate nmos and pmos targets: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objective: 完成「閘介電層串聯」的故障判別表，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for include the dielectric stack, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：閘介電層串聯。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：相同金屬在不同介面堆疊可有不同有效功函數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Include the dielectric stack. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: The same metal can have different effective work functions in different stacks. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「相同金屬在不同介面堆疊可有不同有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for include the dielectric stack: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：閾值抽取定義。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：不同抽取方法會產生不可直接混比的閾值。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。

courses.title: 離子佈植摻雜
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解劑量、射程、損傷及活化，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore dose, range, damage and activation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 佈植目的與輪廓
stages.description: 在「佈植目的與輪廓」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for implant purpose and profiles, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 劑量與濃度
steps.objective: 完成「劑量與濃度」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate dose and concentration, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：劑量與濃度。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂積分題：假設一段厚 10 nm 的均勻區濃度為 10^19 cm^-3；先把厚度換成 cm，再求面劑量，並解釋此方盒輪廓不是實際佈植高斯輪廓。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate dose and concentration. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical integral: a uniform 10 nm region has concentration 10^19 cm^-3. Convert thickness to cm and compute areal dose; explain why this box profile is not a real implantation Gaussian.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「劑量與濃度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate dose and concentration and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「劑量與濃度」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate dose and concentration: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.title: 劑量與濃度的原理
knowledge.text: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

quiz.question: 評估「劑量與濃度」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate dose and concentration?
options: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。
峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
quiz.explanationEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Dopant species and lattice occupation jointly determine electrical behavior. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「摻雜元素與晶格佔位共同決定電性作用。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「摻雜種類」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for choose dopant roles: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：能量與深度。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：能量影響深度，也同時影響損傷分布。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。

Interpretation: Energy affects both depth and damage distribution. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

courses.title: 快速熱退火
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 退火需求
stages.description: 在「退火需求」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for annealing requirements, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 活化與擴散
steps.objective: 完成「活化與擴散」的因果圖，把溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：活化與擴散。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate activation and diffusion. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「活化與擴散」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate activation and diffusion and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「活化與擴散」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate activation and diffusion: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 活化與擴散的原理
knowledge.text: 活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。
knowledge.textEn: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 擴散長度與時間積分的擴散係數相關，因此短而熱與長而冷的處理不能只用最高溫度排序。
knowledge.textEn: Diffusion length relates to integrated diffusivity, so short-hot and long-cool cycles cannot be ranked by peak temperature alone.

quiz.question: 評估「活化與擴散」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate activation and diffusion?
options: 活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。
峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。 擴散長度與時間積分的擴散係數相關，因此短而熱與長而冷的處理不能只用最高溫度排序。
quiz.explanationEn: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. Diffusion length relates to integrated diffusivity, so short-hot and long-cool cycles cannot be ranked by peak temperature alone.

courses.title: 雷射尖峰退火
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 雷射熱歷程
stages.description: 在「雷射熱歷程」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for laser thermal history, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 毫秒與奈秒

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes, connecting relevant limits in beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：毫秒與奈秒。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同脈衝時間不能視為同一熱處理。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「毫秒與奈秒」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「毫秒與奈秒」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：金屬圖案吸收。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：反射率差異使不同區塊接受不同熱負荷。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare patterned absorption. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Reflectivity variations give different blocks different thermal loads. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「反射率差異使不同區塊接受不同熱負荷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「金屬圖案吸收」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 金屬與介電圖案的反射及吸收不同，代表性驗證應包含圖案晶圓而非僅有裸矽校準片。
knowledge.textEn: Metal and dielectric patterns differ optically, so representative validation needs patterned wafers beyond bare-silicon calibration.

quiz.question: 評估「金屬圖案吸收」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

相同雷射能量必定產生相同熱峰值。

Equal laser energy must produce equal thermal peaks.

Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. steps.check: 交付「失效區回溯」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。

Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. courses.title: 擴散爐均勻性控制
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 爐管與邊界
stages.description: 在「爐管與邊界」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for furnace and boundaries, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 批次位置圖
steps.objective: 完成「批次位置圖」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map batch positions, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：批次位置圖。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map batch positions. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「批次位置圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map batch positions and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「批次位置圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map batch positions: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.textEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Finite sources conserve dose while fixed-surface sources replenish dopants; the models have different conservation and boundary conditions.

化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Specify boat loading. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Wafer count and spacing change thermal mass and flow. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：爐溫與片溫。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：爐壁設定值不能直接當作晶圓瞬時溫度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。

Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Wall setpoint is not instantaneous wafer temperature. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate constant and finite sources. Interpretation: Source boundary conditions determine the diffusion solution. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：缺陷促進擴散。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：點缺陷前史會改變有效擴散行為。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess defect-assisted diffusion. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Point-defect history changes effective diffusion behavior. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「點缺陷前史會改變有效擴散行為。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Point-defect history changes effective diffusion behavior. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「缺陷促進擴散」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess defect-assisted diffusion and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「缺陷促進擴散」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for assess defect-assisted diffusion: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for uniformity acceptance, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 徑向與軸向圖
steps.objective: 完成「徑向與軸向圖」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate radial and axial maps, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：徑向與軸向圖。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate radial and axial maps. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
