steps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「徑向與軸向圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate radial and axial maps and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「徑向與軸向圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate radial and axial maps: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 徑向與軸向圖的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate radial and axial maps principle
knowledge.text: 片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。
knowledge.textEn: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
knowledge.textEn: Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

quiz.question: 評估「徑向與軸向圖」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate radial and axial maps?
options: 片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。
空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。
相同雷射能量必定產生相同熱峰值。
optionsEn: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately.
Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity.
Equal laser energy must produce equal thermal peaks.
quiz.explanation: 片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
quiz.explanationEn: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately. Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map sheet resistance. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Equal resistance can arise from different concentration profiles. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「片電阻映射」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for map sheet resistance: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 批次擴散驗收
steps.objective: 完成「批次擴散驗收」的工程驗收單，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept batch diffusion, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：批次擴散驗收。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Accept batch diffusion. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「批次擴散驗收」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept batch diffusion and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「批次擴散驗收」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for accept batch diffusion: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 批次擴散驗收的原理
knowledge.text: 熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。
knowledge.textEn: Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
knowledge.textEn: Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

quiz.question: 評估「批次擴散驗收」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating accept batch diffusion?
options: 空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。
相同雷射能量必定產生相同熱峰值。
熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。
optionsEn: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity.
Equal laser energy must produce equal thermal peaks.
Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together.
quiz.explanation: 熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
quiz.explanationEn: Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together. Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

courses.title: 淺溝槽隔離製作
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore trench fill, isolation leakage and stress through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 隔離幾何
stages.description: 在「隔離幾何」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for isolation geometry, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 主動區邊界
steps.objective: 完成「主動區邊界」的因果圖，把溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw active-area boundaries, connecting relevant limits in trench fill, isolation leakage and stress to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：主動區邊界。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw active-area boundaries. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「主動區邊界」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw active-area boundaries and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「主動區邊界」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw active-area boundaries: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 主動區邊界的原理
knowledge.text: 隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。
knowledge.textEn: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 隔離必須在截面上切斷非預期導通路徑，溝槽名稱或深度單一數值無法完整描述電性隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Isolation must interrupt unintended conduction paths in section; a trench label or single depth cannot fully describe it.

quiz.question: 評估「主動區邊界」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating draw active-area boundaries?
options: 隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。 隔離必須在截面上切斷非預期導通路徑，溝槽名稱或深度單一數值無法完整描述電性隔離。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. Isolation must interrupt unintended conduction paths in section; a trench label or single depth cannot fully describe it.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：溝槽深度預算。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：隔離深度需與接面及漏電路徑一起評估。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget trench depth. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Isolation depth must be assessed against junctions and leakage paths. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離深度需與接面及漏電路徑一起評估。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation depth must be assessed against junctions and leakage paths. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.check: 交付「溝槽深度預算」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for budget trench depth: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：硬遮罩分工。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：遮罩要兼顧蝕刻保護及後續平坦化停止。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assign hard-mask functions. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Masks may provide both etch protection and a planarization stop. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「硬遮罩分工」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for assign hard-mask functions: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for assess pad oxide, connecting relevant limits in trench fill, isolation leakage and stress to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：襯墊氧化層。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：襯墊層可改變應力傳遞與移除選擇性。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess pad oxide. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Pad layers alter stress transfer and removal selectivity. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「襯墊層可改變應力傳遞與移除選擇性。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「襯墊氧化層」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for assess pad oxide: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

Interpretation: Sparse and dense regions can have different etch and fill loading. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：邊角電場。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：尖角可能集中電場而增加局部漏電。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Locate corner fields. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Sharp corners can concentrate fields and increase local leakage. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「尖角可能集中電場而增加局部漏電。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Sharp corners can concentrate fields and increase local leakage. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「邊角電場」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for locate corner fields and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「邊角電場」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for locate corner fields: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 邊角電場的原理
knowledge.text: 尖角可能集中電場而增加局部漏電。
knowledge.textEn: Sharp corners can concentrate fields and increase local leakage.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 隔離必須在截面上切斷非預期導通路徑，溝槽名稱或深度單一數值無法完整描述電性隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Isolation must interrupt unintended conduction paths in section; a trench label or single depth cannot fully describe it.

quiz.question: 評估「邊角電場」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating locate corner fields?
options: 總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
尖角可能集中電場而增加局部漏電。
optionsEn: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
Sharp corners can concentrate fields and increase local leakage.
quiz.explanation: 尖角可能集中電場而增加局部漏電。 隔離必須在截面上切斷非預期導通路徑，溝槽名稱或深度單一數值無法完整描述電性隔離。
quiz.explanationEn: Sharp corners can concentrate fields and increase local leakage. Isolation must interrupt unintended conduction paths in section; a trench label or single depth cannot fully describe it.

stages.title: 溝槽與襯層
stages.description: 在「溝槽與襯層」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for trench and liner, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 溝槽側壁角
steps.objective: 完成「溝槽側壁角」的因果圖，把溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for measure trench sidewall angle, connecting relevant limits in trench fill, isolation leakage and stress to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：溝槽側壁角。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：側壁形狀會改變入口封閉與填充風險。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Measure trench sidewall angle. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Sidewall shape changes opening closure and fill risk. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「側壁形狀會改變入口封閉與填充風險。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Sidewall shape changes opening closure and fill risk. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「溝槽側壁角」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure trench sidewall angle and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「溝槽側壁角」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for measure trench sidewall angle: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 溝槽側壁角的原理
knowledge.text: 側壁形狀會改變入口封閉與填充風險。
knowledge.textEn: Sidewall shape changes opening closure and fill risk.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 側壁形狀與襯層消耗會改變填充前的實際開口，所以設計圖寬度不能直接代替沉積入口寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Sidewall shape and liner consumption change the prefill opening, so layout width is not necessarily deposition-entry width.

quiz.question: 評估「溝槽側壁角」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating measure trench sidewall angle?
options: 側壁形狀會改變入口封閉與填充風險。
幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。
接觸面積加倍必定使全部串聯電阻減半。
optionsEn: Sidewall shape changes opening closure and fill risk.
Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements.
Doubling contact area must halve all series resistance.
quiz.explanation: 側壁形狀會改變入口封閉與填充風險。 側壁形狀與襯層消耗會改變填充前的實際開口，所以設計圖寬度不能直接代替沉積入口寬度。
quiz.explanationEn: Sidewall shape changes opening closure and fill risk. Sidewall shape and liner consumption change the prefill opening, so layout width is not necessarily deposition-entry width.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect trench-bottom residue. Interpretation: Residues can compromise liner and fill interfaces. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

Interpretation: Correct geometry can still contain plasma damage. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare corner rounding. Interpretation: Rounding changes fields and usable active dimensions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.title: 底部與側壁成長

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for leakage and stress, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 窄寬效應

steps.instruction: 本步問題：窄寬效應。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：通道靠近隔離邊界時邊緣影響比例增加。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess narrow-width effects. Interpretation: Edge effects become proportionally larger near isolation boundaries. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Edge effects become proportionally larger near isolation boundaries. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.check: 交付「窄寬效應」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for assess narrow-width effects: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

Interpretation: Equal devices can differ because of distance to isolation boundaries. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

courses.title: 應變矽通道整合
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 應變與輸運

steps.title: 應力與應變

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate stress and strain, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：應力與應變。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂小應變：長度由 100.00 變為 100.10 單位；計算軸向應變，再說明為何缺少彈性常數及邊界條件時不能唯一求應力。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate stress and strain. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical small strain: length changes from 100.00 to 100.10 units. Calculate axial strain and explain why stress is not uniquely known without elastic constants and boundaries.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「應力與應變」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate stress and strain and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「應力與應變」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate stress and strain: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for assess leakage tradeoffs, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：漏電代價。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：提高導通電流仍需維持關斷電流限制。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess leakage tradeoffs. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Higher on-current must still satisfy off-current constraints. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「提高導通電流仍需維持關斷電流限制。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Higher on-current must still satisfy off-current constraints. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「漏電代價」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess leakage tradeoffs and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「漏電代價」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess leakage tradeoffs: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

knowledge.title: 漏電代價的原理
knowledge.text: 提高導通電流仍需維持關斷電流限制。
knowledge.textEn: Higher on-current must still satisfy off-current constraints.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 遷移率提高的收益會受接觸及互連限制；元件電流與電路延遲應分層驗證而非直接同比換算。
knowledge.textEn: Contact and interconnect limits constrain mobility gains; validate device current and circuit delay separately rather than scaling them proportionally.

quiz.question: 評估「漏電代價」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess leakage tradeoffs?
options: 低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。
提高導通電流仍需維持關斷電流限制。
較快成長永遠改善圖案選擇性。
optionsEn: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance.
Higher on-current must still satisfy off-current constraints.
Faster growth always improves pattern selectivity.
quiz.explanation: 提高導通電流仍需維持關斷電流限制。 遷移率提高的收益會受接觸及互連限制；元件電流與電路延遲應分層驗證而非直接同比換算。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher on-current must still satisfy off-current constraints. Contact and interconnect limits constrain mobility gains; validate device current and circuit delay separately rather than scaling them proportionally.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect junction defects. Interpretation: Greater mismatch can introduce relaxation defects and leakage. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for inspect junction defects: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess thermal stability. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Later thermal cycles can change retained strain. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess layout dependence. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Neighboring structures can change stress around otherwise equal devices. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

courses.title: 矽鍺選擇性磊晶
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 選擇性與晶格
stages.description: 在「選擇性與晶格」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for selectivity and lattice, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 選擇性定義
steps.objective: 完成「選擇性定義」的因果圖，把選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define selectivity, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：選擇性定義。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define selectivity. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「選擇性定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define selectivity and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「選擇性定義」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define selectivity: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 選擇性定義的原理
knowledge.text: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。
knowledge.textEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 選擇性磊晶同時追求目標表面成長及非目標表面不成核，必須報告兩種表面的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Selective epitaxy requires growth on target surfaces and suppressed nucleation elsewhere; report both surface outcomes.

quiz.question: 評估「選擇性定義」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define selectivity?
options: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。 選擇性磊晶同時追求目標表面成長及非目標表面不成核，必須報告兩種表面的結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. Selective epitaxy requires growth on target surfaces and suppressed nucleation elsewhere; report both surface outcomes.

steps.title: 鍺比例

Interpretation: Mean surface composition cannot represent a depth gradient. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. steps.check: 交付「鍺深度分布」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map germanium depth profiles: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

courses.title: 平面 CMOS 製程整合
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解井區、接面及互補電路連通，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for cmos function and isolation, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw a complementary inverter and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「互補反相器」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

steps.check: 交付「閘介電層」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

knowledge.textEn: Spacers geometrically relate junction processing to gate edges, but lateral diffusion still changes electrical channel length.

optionsEn: Spacers separate later junction placement from gate edges.
Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements.
Doubling contact area must halve all series resistance.

courses.title: 鰭式電晶體製造
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 鰭幾何與靜電
stages.description: 在「鰭幾何與靜電」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for fin geometry and electrostatics, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 三面閘控制
steps.objective: 完成「三面閘控制」的因果圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw three-sided gate control, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：三面閘控制。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw three-sided gate control. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「三面閘控制」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw three-sided gate control and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「三面閘控制」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw three-sided gate control: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 三面閘控制的原理
knowledge.text: 閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。
knowledge.textEn: Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 對近矩形鰭，三面控制的幾何寬度約隨兩倍鰭高加鰭寬改變；實際電性還受各面遷移率影響。
knowledge.textEn: For a near-rectangular fin, geometric gated width scales roughly as twice height plus width; face-dependent mobility also matters.

quiz.question: 評估「三面閘控制」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating draw three-sided gate control?
options: 閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 閘對鰭側壁與頂面的控制不同於平面元件。 對近矩形鰭，三面控制的幾何寬度約隨兩倍鰭高加鰭寬改變；實際電性還受各面遷移率影響。
quiz.explanationEn: Gate control over fin sides and top differs from planar devices. For a near-rectangular fin, geometric gated width scales roughly as twice height plus width; face-dependent mobility also matters.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Estimate effective channel width. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Effective width relates to fin height, fin width and fin count. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical rectangular fin: height 30 and width 8 units. Use 2H+W to compare one and two fins, then explain nonproportional current from face mobility, contacts and capacitance.

steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Effective width relates to fin height, fin width and fin count. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「有效通道寬」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for estimate effective channel width and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「有效通道寬」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for estimate effective channel width: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Integer fin counts constrain continuous drive sizing. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

Interpretation: Smaller pitch also increases fill and isolation difficulty. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.title: 短通道指標

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for choose short-channel metrics, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：短通道指標。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：導通電流需與關斷漏電及汲極耦合一起比較。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose short-channel metrics. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Compare on-current with off-leakage and drain coupling. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「導通電流需與關斷漏電及汲極耦合一起比較。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Compare on-current with off-leakage and drain coupling. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「短通道指標」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for choose short-channel metrics and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「短通道指標」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for choose short-channel metrics: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

knowledge.title: 短通道指標的原理
knowledge.text: 導通電流需與關斷漏電及汲極耦合一起比較。
knowledge.textEn: Compare on-current with off-leakage and drain coupling.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 對近矩形鰭，三面控制的幾何寬度約隨兩倍鰭高加鰭寬改變；實際電性還受各面遷移率影響。
knowledge.textEn: For a near-rectangular fin, geometric gated width scales roughly as twice height plus width; face-dependent mobility also matters.

quiz.question: 評估「短通道指標」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating choose short-channel metrics?
options: 總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
導通電流需與關斷漏電及汲極耦合一起比較。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Compare on-current with off-leakage and drain coupling.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 導通電流需與關斷漏電及汲極耦合一起比較。 對近矩形鰭，三面控制的幾何寬度約隨兩倍鰭高加鰭寬改變；實際電性還受各面遷移率影響。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare on-current with off-leakage and drain coupling. For a near-rectangular fin, geometric gated width scales roughly as twice height plus width; face-dependent mobility also matters.

steps.title: 版圖測試車
steps.objective: 完成「版圖測試車」的工程驗收單，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：版圖測試車。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：不同鰭數與密度需要可比較測試結構。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Lay out a test vehicle. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Fin count and density variants need comparable test structures. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同鰭數與密度需要可比較測試結構。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Fin count and density variants need comparable test structures. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「版圖測試車」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for lay out a test vehicle and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「版圖測試車」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for lay out a test vehicle: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.title: 鰭與隔離
stages.description: 在「鰭與隔離」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for fins and isolation, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 鰭圖案轉移
steps.objective: 完成「鰭圖案轉移」的因果圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for track fin pattern transfer, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：鰭圖案轉移。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：硬遮罩與蝕刻偏差會累積到最終鰭寬。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Track fin pattern transfer. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Hard-mask and etch biases accumulate into final fin width. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「硬遮罩與蝕刻偏差會累積到最終鰭寬。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Hard-mask and etch biases accumulate into final fin width. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「鰭圖案轉移」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for track fin pattern transfer and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「鰭圖案轉移」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for track fin pattern transfer: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 鰭圖案轉移的原理
knowledge.text: 硬遮罩與蝕刻偏差會累積到最終鰭寬。
knowledge.textEn: Hard-mask and etch biases accumulate into final fin width.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 鰭寬、側壁角與隔離回蝕高度共同定義通道截面，三者量測應配準到同一位置。
knowledge.textEn: Fin width, taper and isolation recess jointly define the channel section and need co-registered measurements.

quiz.question: 評估「鰭圖案轉移」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating track fin pattern transfer?
options: 硬遮罩與蝕刻偏差會累積到最終鰭寬。
幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。
接觸面積加倍必定使全部串聯電阻減半。
optionsEn: Hard-mask and etch biases accumulate into final fin width.
Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements.
Doubling contact area must halve all series resistance.
quiz.explanation: 硬遮罩與蝕刻偏差會累積到最終鰭寬。 鰭寬、側壁角與隔離回蝕高度共同定義通道截面，三者量測應配準到同一位置。
quiz.explanationEn: Hard-mask and etch biases accumulate into final fin width. Fin width, taper and isolation recess jointly define the channel section and need co-registered measurements.

steps.title: 鰭側壁角

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Measure fin taper. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Top-bottom width differences alter fields and effective cross-section. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「鰭側壁角」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure fin taper and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「鰭側壁角」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for measure fin taper: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：鰭粗糙度。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：邊緣起伏可轉為局部通道寬度變異。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map fin roughness. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Edge fluctuations translate into local channel-width variation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「邊緣起伏可轉為局部通道寬度變異。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「鰭粗糙度」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for map fin roughness: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：隔離填充。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：鰭間填充要避免空洞與不均應力。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect isolation fill. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Inter-fin fill must avoid voids and nonuniform stress. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「鰭間填充要避免空洞與不均應力。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for inspect isolation fill: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.objective: 完成「鰭切割」的工程驗收單，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：鰭切割。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：切割位置決定哪些鰭區實際連通。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define fin cuts. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Fin cuts define actual connectivity between fin regions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「切割位置決定哪些鰭區實際連通。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Fin cuts define actual connectivity between fin regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「鰭切割」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for define fin cuts: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.title: 三維閘與接觸
stages.description: 在「三維閘與接觸」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for 3d gates and contacts, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 三維介電覆蓋
steps.objective: 完成「三維介電覆蓋」的因果圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess 3d dielectric coverage, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：三維介電覆蓋。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess 3D dielectric coverage. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「三維介電覆蓋」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess 3d dielectric coverage and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「三維介電覆蓋」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for assess 3d dielectric coverage: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 三維介電覆蓋的原理
knowledge.text: 頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 三維閘堆疊增加側壁及角落界面，單一平面監控片不能完全代表成核、覆蓋與填充。
knowledge.textEn: Three-dimensional gates add sidewall and corner interfaces; one planar monitor cannot fully represent nucleation, coverage and fill.

quiz.question: 評估「三維介電覆蓋」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess 3d dielectric coverage?
options: 頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。
節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。
模擬最佳值可直接當成量產良率。
optionsEn: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage.
The node name is a measured physical gate length.
The best simulation value directly represents production yield.
quiz.explanation: 頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。 三維閘堆疊增加側壁及角落界面，單一平面監控片不能完全代表成核、覆蓋與填充。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. Three-dimensional gates add sidewall and corner interfaces; one planar monitor cannot fully represent nucleation, coverage and fill.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect replacement-gate cavities. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Narrow cavities must accommodate dielectric, work-function and fill layers. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「窄腔需容納介電層、功函數層與填充金屬。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「替換閘腔」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for inspect replacement-gate cavities: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

courses.title: 環繞閘極奈米片電晶體
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 奈米片堆疊

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for nanosheet stacks, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 環繞閘拓撲
steps.objective: 完成「環繞閘拓撲」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw the gate-all-around topology, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：環繞閘拓撲。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw the gate-all-around topology. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「環繞閘拓撲」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw the gate-all-around topology and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「環繞閘拓撲」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw the gate-all-around topology: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 奈米片有效通道寬與片周長及片數相關，但片間空間同時限制閘金屬體積。

quiz.explanation: 閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。 奈米片有效通道寬與片周長及片數相關，但片間空間同時限制閘金屬體積。
quiz.explanationEn: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. Effective channel width relates to sheet perimeter and count, while inter-sheet spacing limits gate-metal volume.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget inter-sheet spacing. Interpretation: Spacing must fit dielectric, work-function and gate metal. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Calculate remaining fill space and test margin after increasing each face’s work-function layer by 1 unit.

stages.title: 釋放與環繞閘
stages.description: 在「釋放與環繞閘」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for release and wraparound gate, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 犧牲層選蝕
steps.objective: 完成「犧牲層選蝕」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess sacrificial-layer selectivity, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：犧牲層選蝕。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：需要移除犧牲層而盡量保留通道。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess sacrificial-layer selectivity. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Sacrificial material must be removed while preserving channels. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「需要移除犧牲層而盡量保留通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Sacrificial material must be removed while preserving channels. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「犧牲層選蝕」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess sacrificial-layer selectivity and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「犧牲層選蝕」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for assess sacrificial-layer selectivity: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 犧牲層選蝕的原理
knowledge.text: 需要移除犧牲層而盡量保留通道。
knowledge.textEn: Sacrificial material must be removed while preserving channels.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 釋放讓通道失去原先的連續支撐，也暴露更多表面；機械穩定與表面損傷需要同步驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Release removes continuous support and exposes more surface, requiring simultaneous checks of mechanical stability and surface damage.

quiz.question: 評估「犧牲層選蝕」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess sacrificial-layer selectivity?
options: 需要移除犧牲層而盡量保留通道。
節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。
模擬最佳值可直接當成量產良率。
optionsEn: Sacrificial material must be removed while preserving channels.
The node name is a measured physical gate length.
The best simulation value directly represents production yield.
quiz.explanation: 需要移除犧牲層而盡量保留通道。 釋放讓通道失去原先的連續支撐，也暴露更多表面；機械穩定與表面損傷需要同步驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Sacrificial material must be removed while preserving channels. Release removes continuous support and exposes more surface, requiring simultaneous checks of mechanical stability and surface damage.

steps.title: 釋放完整性
steps.objective: 完成「釋放完整性」的對照表，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for check release completeness, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：釋放完整性。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：入口已開不代表最深處已完全釋放。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Check release completeness. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: An open entrance does not prove complete release at depth. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「入口已開不代表最深處已完全釋放。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: An open entrance does not prove complete release at depth. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「釋放完整性」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for check release completeness and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「釋放完整性」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for check release completeness: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：通道塌陷。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：釋放後支撐及表面力可能改變幾何。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect sheet collapse. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Support and surface forces can change geometry after release. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「釋放後支撐及表面力可能改變幾何。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for inspect sheet collapse and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「通道塌陷」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for inspect sheet collapse: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 環繞介電層
steps.objective: 完成「環繞介電層」的故障判別表，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for inspect wraparound dielectric, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：環繞介電層。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：四面及片間都需要連續介電覆蓋。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect wraparound dielectric. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Continuous dielectric is needed around sheets and between layers. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「四面及片間都需要連續介電覆蓋。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for inspect wraparound dielectric and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「環繞介電層」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for inspect wraparound dielectric: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：功函數金屬。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：最窄間隙決定材料堆疊可用空間。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget work-function metal. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: The narrowest gap limits available stack space. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「最窄間隙決定材料堆疊可用空間。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The narrowest gap limits available stack space. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「功函數金屬」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget work-function metal and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「功函數金屬」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for budget work-function metal: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：閘填充空洞。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：片間金屬不連續可能影響閘控制及電阻。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Locate gate-fill voids. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Discontinuous inter-sheet metal can affect gate control and resistance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「片間金屬不連續可能影響閘控制及電阻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for locate gate-fill voids and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「閘填充空洞」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for locate gate-fill voids: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.title: 每層及電路驗證

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for per-sheet and circuit validation, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 每層電性差
steps.objective: 完成「每層電性差」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess per-sheet differences, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：每層電性差。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：總電流合格可能掩蓋某一層失效。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess per-sheet differences. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Acceptable total current can hide one failed layer. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「總電流合格可能掩蓋某一層失效。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptable total current can hide one failed layer. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「每層電性差」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess per-sheet differences and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「每層電性差」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

courses.title: 互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for complementary stacked architecture, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw vertical complementary stacking. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「垂直互補配置」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw vertical complementary stacking and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「垂直互補配置」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡

Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：自熱與交互加熱。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：一層發熱可能改變另一層的電性。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess mutual heating. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Heating one tier can alter the other's electrical behavior. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「一層發熱可能改變另一層的電性。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：CFET 證據地圖。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assemble a CFET evidence map. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Report isolation, both polarities, contacts, circuits and repeatability separately. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

courses.title: 埋入式電源軌整合
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 電源路徑
stages.description: 在「電源路徑」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for power pathways, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 電源與訊號分離
steps.objective: 完成「電源與訊號分離」的因果圖，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate power and signals, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：電源與訊號分離。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate power and signals. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「電源與訊號分離」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate power and signals and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「電源與訊號分離」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate power and signals: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.textEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity.

optionsEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.

quiz.explanationEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. A buried rail is a local power structure; frontside or backside entry is a separate design dimension requiring a complete loop.

steps.title: 正面與背面入口

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for compare front and back access, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：正面與背面入口。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：有埋入軌不代表必然由背面供電。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare front and back access. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Buried rails do not necessarily imply backside delivery. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

courses.title: 次二奈米邏輯製程研究
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Interpret node names. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret node names and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「節點名稱」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

steps.title: 功耗效能面積

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for separate ppa metrics, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：功耗效能面積。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：功耗、效能與面積通常不能同時單獨最佳化。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自行建立三個候選架構的正規化 PPA 表，包含一個低功耗但面積較大方案；標明全部是假設，找出 Pareto 不被支配集合而非加總不相容單位。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate PPA metrics. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Power, performance and area generally cannot be independently optimized together. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Create hypothetical normalized PPA data for three architectures including a low-power, larger-area option. Identify the nondominated Pareto set rather than adding incompatible units.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「功耗、效能與面積通常不能同時單獨最佳化。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Power, performance and area generally cannot be independently optimized together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「功耗效能面積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate ppa metrics and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「功耗效能面積」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for separate ppa metrics: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.title: 功耗效能面積的原理
knowledge.text: 功耗、效能與面積通常不能同時單獨最佳化。
knowledge.textEn: Power, performance and area generally cannot be independently optimized together.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 節點比較需要明確 PPA、工作負載及幾何基準，商業名稱與研究預測不可直接充當性能證據。
knowledge.textEn: Node comparisons require explicit PPA, workload and geometry baselines; commercial names and projections are not performance evidence.

quiz.question: 評估「功耗效能面積」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate ppa metrics?
options: 功耗、效能與面積通常不能同時單獨最佳化。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: Power, performance and area generally cannot be independently optimized together.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 功耗、效能與面積通常不能同時單獨最佳化。 節點比較需要明確 PPA、工作負載及幾何基準，商業名稱與研究預測不可直接充當性能證據。

steps.title: 模型與量測

steps.instruction: 本步問題：模型與量測。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：模擬預測、單元展示與量產數據不可混稱。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Classify evidence types. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Predictions, test demonstrations and production data are distinct evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「模型與量測」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for classify evidence types: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.objective: 完成「不確定度帳本」的工程驗收單，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：不確定度帳本。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：公開缺失參數須標記未知，不能補成廠商規格。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Create an uncertainty ledger. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Missing public parameters remain unknown rather than invented specifications. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「公開缺失參數須標記未知，不能補成廠商規格。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for create an uncertainty ledger: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.title: 元件及圖案
stages.description: 在「元件及圖案」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for devices and patterning, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 奈米片選項
steps.objective: 完成「奈米片選項」的因果圖，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compare nanosheet options, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：奈米片選項。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：寬度可調與堆疊製程限制需一起比較。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare nanosheet options. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Width flexibility must be weighed against stack-processing limits. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「寬度可調與堆疊製程限制需一起比較。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Width flexibility must be weighed against stack-processing limits. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「奈米片選項」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare nanosheet options and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「奈米片選項」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for compare nanosheet options: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 奈米片選項的原理
knowledge.text: 寬度可調與堆疊製程限制需一起比較。
knowledge.textEn: Width flexibility must be weighed against stack-processing limits.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 架構改變會同時影響靜電、電容與加工可達性，單項通道指標的改善不等於整合方案更優。
knowledge.textEn: Architecture changes electrostatics, capacitance and process access; improving one channel metric does not prove a better integrated solution.

quiz.question: 評估「奈米片選項」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating compare nanosheet options?
options: 寬度可調與堆疊製程限制需一起比較。
幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。
接觸面積加倍必定使全部串聯電阻減半。
optionsEn: Width flexibility must be weighed against stack-processing limits.
Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements.
Doubling contact area must halve all series resistance.
quiz.explanation: 寬度可調與堆疊製程限制需一起比較。 架構改變會同時影響靜電、電容與加工可達性，單項通道指標的改善不等於整合方案更優。
quiz.explanationEn: Width flexibility must be weighed against stack-processing limits. Architecture changes electrostatics, capacitance and process access; improving one channel metric does not prove a better integrated solution.
