steps.instruction: 本步問題：Forksheet 選項。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：介電牆改變 n-p 間距與閘加工空間。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess forksheet options. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: A dielectric wall changes n-p separation and gate-processing space. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「介電牆改變 n-p 間距與閘加工空間。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A dielectric wall changes n-p separation and gate-processing space. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「Forksheet 選項」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess forksheet options and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「Forksheet 選項」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess forksheet options: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：CFET 選項。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：垂直互補可省平面面積但增加上下接觸難題。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess CFET options. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Vertical complementarity saves lateral area but complicates tier contacts. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「垂直互補可省平面面積但增加上下接觸難題。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「CFET 選項」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for assess cfet options: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate SRAM constraints. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Memory-cell stability differs from logic-delay optimization. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for research evidence, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 變異來源
steps.objective: 完成「變異來源」的因果圖，把比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for build a variability budget, connecting relevant limits in comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：變異來源。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：幾何、材料與隨機缺陷需分開估算。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Build a variability budget. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Geometry, materials and stochastic defects need separate estimates. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「幾何、材料與隨機缺陷需分開估算。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Geometry, materials and stochastic defects need separate estimates. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「變異來源」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for build a variability budget and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「變異來源」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for build a variability budget: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.textEn: Geometry, materials and stochastic defects need separate estimates.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 模擬、測試結構與量產資料的抽樣範圍不同，研究結論應附樣本、偏壓、模型假設及可重現條件。
knowledge.textEn: Simulations, test structures and production data sample different scopes; state samples, bias, model assumptions and reproducibility conditions.

quiz.question: 評估「變異來源」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating build a variability budget?

optionsEn: Geometry, materials and stochastic defects need separate estimates.
One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer.
Low resistance automatically proves dielectric isolation.

quiz.explanationEn: Geometry, materials and stochastic defects need separate estimates. Simulations, test structures and production data sample different scopes; state samples, bias, model assumptions and reproducibility conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define reliability conditions. Interpretation: Accelerated stress tests need an interpretable extrapolation model. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Connect yield and cost. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Smaller dies do not guarantee lower cost per good die. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

Interpretation: Roadmaps are dated projections rather than delivery commitments. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

courses.title: 奈米片內側間隔層製作
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 間隔層功能

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for spacer functions, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate inner and outer spacers, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：內外間隔差別。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate inner and outer spacers. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「內外間隔差別」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate inner and outer spacers and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「內外間隔差別」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate inner and outer spacers: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：寄生電容。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：介電常數與實際幾何共同決定耦合。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 以平行板近似 C∝kA/d 做相對比較：固定面積，將 k 降為 0.8、間距降為 0.8；求電容比，說明低 k 與幾何縮放可能互相抵銷。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Estimate parasitic coupling. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Permittivity and actual geometry jointly determine coupling. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Use relative C∝kA/d at fixed area: both k and spacing become 0.8 of their initial values. Compute the ratio and explain cancellation between lower k and geometric scaling.

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for assess overetch: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

knowledge.title: 過蝕風險的原理
knowledge.text: 延長處理以清除最慢位置會增加其他區域損失。
knowledge.textEn: Extending treatment for the slowest region increases loss elsewhere.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 各層凹蝕的平均深度及最差偏差都重要，局部過深會改變存取長度，過淺則減少保護裕度。
knowledge.textEn: Mean and worst-layer recess matter: excessive recess alters access length while shallow recess reduces protection margin.

quiz.question: 評估「過蝕風險」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess overetch?

延長處理以清除最慢位置會增加其他區域損失。
平均成分足以排除局部相分離。
optionsEn: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation.
Extending treatment for the slowest region increases loss elsewhere.
Mean composition rules out local phase separation.
quiz.explanation: 延長處理以清除最慢位置會增加其他區域損失。 各層凹蝕的平均深度及最差偏差都重要，局部過深會改變存取長度，過淺則減少保護裕度。
quiz.explanationEn: Extending treatment for the slowest region increases loss elsewhere. Mean and worst-layer recess matter: excessive recess alters access length while shallow recess reduces protection margin.

steps.title: 圖案負載

steps.instruction: 本步問題：圖案負載。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：密集與稀疏結構需分別驗證凹蝕。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare pattern loading. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Dense and sparse structures need separate recess validation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「密集與稀疏結構需分別驗證凹蝕。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Dense and sparse structures need separate recess validation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「圖案負載」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare pattern loading and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「圖案負載」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for compare pattern loading: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.description: 在「填充與回蝕」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for fill and etchback, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 低介電材料
steps.objective: 完成「低介電材料」的因果圖，把側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compare low-k materials, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：低介電材料。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare low-k materials. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「低介電材料」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare low-k materials and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「低介電材料」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for compare low-k materials: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 低介電材料的原理
knowledge.text: 低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。
knowledge.textEn: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 沉積與回蝕必須形成內部保留、外部清除的幾何選擇性，不能只憑全面膜厚判定成功。
knowledge.textEn: Deposition and etchback must retain recessed material while clearing exposed surfaces; blanket thickness cannot establish success.

quiz.question: 評估「低介電材料」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating compare low-k materials?
options: 低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。
高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。
去除上層材料不需檢查下層損失。
optionsEn: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness.
High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps.
Removing an upper layer needs no lower-layer loss check.
quiz.explanation: 低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。 沉積與回蝕必須形成內部保留、外部清除的幾何選擇性，不能只憑全面膜厚判定成功。
quiz.explanationEn: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. Deposition and etchback must retain recessed material while clearing exposed surfaces; blanket thickness cannot establish success.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for assess conformal deposition, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：共形沉積。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：厚度共形還需檢查成分共形。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess conformal deposition. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Thickness conformality also needs compositional conformality. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「厚度共形還需檢查成分共形。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness conformality also needs compositional conformality. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「共形沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess conformal deposition and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「共形沉積」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess conformal deposition: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for predict opening closure, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：腔口封閉。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：入口較快成長可能留下隱藏空洞。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Predict opening closure. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Faster entrance growth can trap hidden voids. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「入口較快成長可能留下隱藏空洞。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Faster entrance growth can trap hidden voids. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「腔口封閉」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for predict opening closure and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「腔口封閉」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for predict opening closure: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for check etchback selectivity, connecting relevant limits in lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：回蝕選擇性。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：需去除外部材料而保留凹槽中的內間隔。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Check etchback selectivity. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: External material must be removed while retaining recessed spacers. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「需去除外部材料而保留凹槽中的內間隔。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for check etchback selectivity: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect sheet-end residue. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Endpoint residues can obstruct source-drain epitaxy. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

courses.title: 源汲極接觸電阻控制
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 電阻分解
stages.description: 在「電阻分解」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for resistance decomposition, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 電阻與比接觸電阻
steps.objective: 完成「電阻與比接觸電阻」的因果圖，把活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate resistance and resistivity, connecting relevant limits in activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：電阻與比接觸電阻。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：接觸電阻與比接觸電阻的單位不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate resistance and resistivity. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「接觸電阻與比接觸電阻的單位不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「電阻與比接觸電阻」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate resistance and resistivity and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「電阻與比接觸電阻」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate resistance and resistivity: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 電阻與比接觸電阻的原理

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 接觸電流可集中在入口附近，傳輸長度將片電阻與界面電阻相連，幾何面積不一定全都有效。
knowledge.textEn: Contact current can crowd near edges; transfer length connects sheet and interface resistance, so not all geometric area is effective.

Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.

knowledge.text: 比較需使用相同面積定義與摻雜狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Comparisons need matching area definitions and doping conditions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡

knowledge.textEn: Contact current can crowd near edges; transfer length connects sheet and interface resistance, so not all geometric area is effective.

厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
比較需使用相同面積定義與摻雜狀態。
optionsEn: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
Comparisons need matching area definitions and doping conditions.
quiz.explanation: 比較需使用相同面積定義與摻雜狀態。 接觸電流可集中在入口附近，傳輸長度將片電阻與界面電阻相連，幾何面積不一定全都有效。

steps.title: 表面氧化殘留

steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Even thin residual layers can significantly increase interface resistance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「表面氧化殘留」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.check: 交付「表面氧化殘留」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for assess residual oxide: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for lay out a tlm array, connecting relevant limits in activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：TLM 長度陣列。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂長接觸 TLM：總電阻對間距的直線截距為 20 Ω。於兩接觸相同且寄生已去除假設下，求單接觸電阻；說明未有寬度與片電阻時不能直接得到比接觸電阻。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Lay out a TLM array. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical long-contact TLM: resistance-versus-spacing intercept is 20 Ω. With equal contacts and removed parasitics, find one contact resistance; explain why width and sheet resistance are still needed for specific contact resistivity.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「TLM 長度陣列」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for lay out a tlm array and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「TLM 長度陣列」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for lay out a tlm array: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.titleEn: Lay out a TLM array principle
knowledge.text: 不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: TLM 的斜率與截距需在適當模型下分離片電阻及接觸貢獻，短接觸與有限幾何會改變抽取。
knowledge.textEn: TLM slope and intercept separate sheet and contact contributions within an appropriate model; finite and short contacts affect extraction.

quiz.question: 評估「TLM 長度陣列」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating lay out a tlm array?
options: 不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。
高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。
去除上層材料不需檢查下層損失。
optionsEn: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information.
High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps.
Removing an upper layer needs no lower-layer loss check.
quiz.explanation: 不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。 TLM 的斜率與截距需在適當模型下分離片電阻及接觸貢獻，短接觸與有限幾何會改變抽取。
quiz.explanationEn: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information. TLM slope and intercept separate sheet and contact contributions within an appropriate model; finite and short contacts affect extraction.

courses.title: 自我對準接觸孔製程
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 接觸與套刻
stages.description: 在「接觸與套刻」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for contacts and overlay, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：自對準的含義。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define self-alignment. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

knowledge.textEn: Directional etching controls shape while selectivity controls protective-layer loss; quantify these capabilities separately.

quiz.question: 評估「離子方向性」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess ion directionality?
options: 方向性有助向下去除但仍可能傷害角落。
入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。
平均成分足以排除局部相分離。
optionsEn: Directionality helps downward removal but can still damage corners.
Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation.
Mean composition rules out local phase separation.
quiz.explanation: 方向性有助向下去除但仍可能傷害角落。 方向性蝕刻控制形狀，材料選擇性控制保護層損失，兩種能力需要分開量化。
quiz.explanationEn: Directionality helps downward removal but can still damage corners. Directional etching controls shape while selectivity controls protective-layer loss; quantify these capabilities separately.

steps.title: 原子層蝕刻循環
steps.objective: 完成「原子層蝕刻循環」的對照表，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for decompose an ale cycle, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：原子層蝕刻循環。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：表面改質與移除需作為分開的作用理解。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Decompose an ALE cycle. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Surface modification and removal are distinct operations. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「表面改質與移除需作為分開的作用理解。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Surface modification and removal are distinct operations. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：入口飽和就證明深槽底部已飽和。 應回到「原子層蝕刻循環」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Entrance saturation proves deep-feature bottom saturation. Revisit assumptions and sampling for decompose an ale cycle and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「原子層蝕刻循環」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for decompose an ale cycle: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

Interpretation: An open hole does not prove a clean contact interface. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for inspect bottom residue: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Measure corner loss. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Mean spacer thickness does not represent the thinnest corner. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「平均間隔厚度不能代表最薄角落。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for measure corner loss: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare microloading. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Hole density and size can cause different clearing times. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同孔密度及尺寸可能有不同清除時間。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Overetch for slow holes consumes protection elsewhere. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「最慢孔清除所需過蝕會消耗其他位置保護層。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for separate endpoint and overetch: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Polymer and metal residues need different interpretation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「聚合物與金屬殘留可能需要不同判讀。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify post-etch residues and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「蝕刻後殘留」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for classify post-etch residues: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

courses.title: 深紫外光阻塗佈
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for resist and substrate, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for match exposure wavelength and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「曝光波長匹配」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

knowledge.text: 旋塗的流動受黏度、離心效應與溶劑揮發共同影響，材料換批後應重新確認曲線而非只沿用轉速。
knowledge.textEn: Spin flow depends on viscosity, centrifugal effects and evaporation; a material-lot change requires curve verification beyond reusing speed.

Softbake and PEB are the same chemical step.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Interpret radial striations. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Striations should be compared with rotation, airflow and drying conditions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「條紋應與旋轉、氣流及乾燥條件對照。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret radial striations and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「放射條紋」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。

Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Report mean thickness and within-wafer nonuniformity together. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Check optical constants. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for check optical constants and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「光學常數」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for check optical constants: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 光學常數的原理
knowledge.text: 膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength.

Interpretation: Substrate reflection changes exposure distribution within resist. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「反射與底層」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess substrate reflectivity: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Release the DUV coating. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Thickness, edge, backside and defect evidence must accompany exposure handoff. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

courses.title: 光阻烘烤與顯影控制
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 烘烤機制
stages.description: 在「烘烤機制」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for bake mechanisms, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 軟烤與 PEB

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate softbake and peb, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：軟烤與 PEB。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate softbake and PEB. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「軟烤與 PEB」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate softbake and peb and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「軟烤與 PEB」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate softbake and peb: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 軟烤與 PEB的原理
knowledge.text: 除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 軟烤調整溶劑與薄膜狀態，PEB 驅動曝光後反應；兩者的合格結果應以各自的物理目的定義。
knowledge.textEn: Softbake adjusts solvent and film state while PEB drives post-exposure reaction; accept each against its own physical purpose.

quiz.explanationEn: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. Softbake adjusts solvent and film state while PEB drives post-exposure reaction; accept each against its own physical purpose.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：熱板與片溫。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：設定溫度不能等同於光阻瞬間溫度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate hotplate and wafer temperature. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Setpoint does not equal instantaneous resist temperature. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate hotplate and wafer temperature and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「熱板與片溫」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for separate hotplate and wafer temperature: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：表面中和。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：空氣鹼性污染可能改變上表面反應。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess surface neutralization. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Airborne bases can change reactions near the top surface. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「空氣鹼性污染可能改變上表面反應。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Airborne bases can change reactions near the top surface. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：曝光劑量相同就能排除所有尺寸差。 應回到「表面中和」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal dose rules out every dimensional difference. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess surface neutralization and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「表面中和」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for assess surface neutralization: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Build a PEB window. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Reaction completion, dimensions and roughness need joint tradeoffs. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate positive and negative tone. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Remaining regions depend on both resist chemistry and developer. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.failure: 常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「正負型溶解」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate positive and negative tone and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「正負型溶解」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate positive and negative tone: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 顯影產物移除受局部傳質限制，厚膜或細孔的清除不能由平面大開口結果直接預測。
knowledge.textEn: Product removal depends on local transport, so thick-film or small-hole clearance cannot follow directly from large planar openings.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for review developer compatibility and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「顯影液相容」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。

quiz.question: 評估「液膜更新」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

options: 顯影產物累積會改變局部傳輸。
較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。
平均線寬合格即可忽略橋接與缺孔。
optionsEn: Accumulated dissolution products change local transport.
Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together.
Acceptable mean width permits ignoring bridges and missing holes.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Measure dark erosion. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Unexposed retained regions can also thin during development. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「未曝光保留區也可能在顯影中變薄。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Unexposed retained regions can also thin during development. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「暗蝕損失」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure dark erosion and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「暗蝕損失」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for measure dark erosion: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define rinse termination. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Rinsing affects reaction termination and product removal and belongs in the timeline. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「沖洗改變反應與溶解產物移除，需納入時間線。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「沖洗終止」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for define rinse termination: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.title: 圖案驗收
stages.description: 在「圖案驗收」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for pattern acceptance, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 底部殘膠
steps.objective: 完成「底部殘膠」的因果圖，把軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify scum, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：底部殘膠。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：上方開口不代表底部已完全清除。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify scum. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: An opening at the top does not prove complete bottom clearance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「上方開口不代表底部已完全清除。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: An opening at the top does not prove complete bottom clearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「底部殘膠」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify scum and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「底部殘膠」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for identify scum: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 底部殘膠的原理
knowledge.text: 上方開口不代表底部已完全清除。
knowledge.textEn: An opening at the top does not prove complete bottom clearance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 尺寸、底部殘膠與側壁角是互補圖案指標；頂視 CD 合格仍可能無法完成後續蝕刻轉移。
knowledge.textEn: CD, bottom scum and sidewall angle are complementary; acceptable top-view CD can still fail later etch transfer.

quiz.question: 評估「底部殘膠」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating identify scum?
options: 上方開口不代表底部已完全清除。
顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。
增加酸擴散永遠只會改善圖案。
optionsEn: An opening at the top does not prove complete bottom clearance.
Developer compatibility follows directly from color.
More acid diffusion can only improve patterns.
quiz.explanation: 上方開口不代表底部已完全清除。 尺寸、底部殘膠與側壁角是互補圖案指標；頂視 CD 合格仍可能無法完成後續蝕刻轉移。
quiz.explanationEn: An opening at the top does not prove complete bottom clearance. CD, bottom scum and sidewall angle are complementary; acceptable top-view CD can still fail later etch transfer.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Measure sidewall angle. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Equal top-view dimensions can hide different bottom dimensions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頂視尺寸相同可能有不同底部尺寸。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure sidewall angle and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「側壁角度」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for measure sidewall angle: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess pattern collapse. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Slender patterns can fail under capillary forces during drying. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「高細長圖案在乾燥中可能受毛細力破壞。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「圖案倒塌」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for assess pattern collapse: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Attribute CD bias. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Exposure, PEB and development can all cause final CD bias. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for design a dose-bake matrix: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. courses.title: 化學放大型光阻設計
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 配方功能分工
stages.description: 在「配方功能分工」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for formulation functions, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 放大機制定義
steps.objective: 完成「放大機制定義」的因果圖，把PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define amplification, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：放大機制定義。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define amplification. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「放大機制定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define amplification and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「放大機制定義」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define amplification: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 放大機制定義的原理
knowledge.text: 光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。
knowledge.textEn: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 化學放大將光吸收與多次催化轉換連起來，但產酸效率、淬熄及溶解反應決定有效增益。
knowledge.textEn: Chemical amplification links absorption to multiple catalytic conversions, while acid yield, quenching and dissolution set effective gain.

quiz.question: 評估「放大機制定義」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define amplification?
options: 光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。
相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。
軟烤與 PEB 可視為相同化學步驟。
optionsEn: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions.
Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps.
Softbake and PEB are the same chemical step.
quiz.explanation: 光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。 化學放大將光吸收與多次催化轉換連起來，但產酸效率、淬熄及溶解反應決定有效增益。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assign protecting groups. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Protecting-group conversion changes resin affinity to developer. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「保護基轉換使樹脂對顯影液的親和改變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「樹脂保護基」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assign protecting groups: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for choose film-formation evidence, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：溶劑與成膜。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：溶液均勻不保證乾膜成分分布均勻。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose film-formation evidence. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: A uniform solution does not guarantee uniform dry-film composition. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「溶液均勻不保證乾膜成分分布均勻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A uniform solution does not guarantee uniform dry-film composition. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「溶劑與成膜」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for choose film-formation evidence and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「溶劑與成膜」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for choose film-formation evidence: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

knowledge.title: 溶劑與成膜的原理
knowledge.text: 溶液均勻不保證乾膜成分分布均勻。
knowledge.textEn: A uniform solution does not guarantee uniform dry-film composition.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 化學放大將光吸收與多次催化轉換連起來，但產酸效率、淬熄及溶解反應決定有效增益。
knowledge.textEn: Chemical amplification links absorption to multiple catalytic conversions, while acid yield, quenching and dissolution set effective gain.

quiz.question: 評估「溶劑與成膜」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating choose film-formation evidence?
options: 相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。
溶液均勻不保證乾膜成分分布均勻。
軟烤與 PEB 可視為相同化學步驟。
optionsEn: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps.
A uniform solution does not guarantee uniform dry-film composition.
Softbake and PEB are the same chemical step.
quiz.explanation: 溶液均勻不保證乾膜成分分布均勻。 化學放大將光吸收與多次催化轉換連起來，但產酸效率、淬熄及溶解反應決定有效增益。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess wavelength compatibility. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Absorption must match exposure wavelength and film thickness. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「波長相容」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Estimate absorption depth. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Excessive absorption can produce through-film reaction gradients. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「過強吸收可能造成上下層反應不均。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 擴散長度與反應速率是不同參數，藉獨立圖案或時間實驗才能避免把反應加快誤判為酸移動更遠。
knowledge.textEn: Diffusion length and reaction rate are different parameters; independent spatial or time experiments avoid confusing faster reaction with farther transport.

quiz.question: 評估「吸收深度」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating estimate absorption depth?
options: 過強吸收可能造成上下層反應不均。

頂視開口就證明孔底完全沒有殘膠。
optionsEn: Excessive absorption can produce through-film reaction gradients.

quiz.explanation: 過強吸收可能造成上下層反應不均。 擴散長度與反應速率是不同參數，藉獨立圖案或時間實驗才能避免把反應加快誤判為酸移動更遠。

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess acid-generation statistics: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare sensitivity-resolution-roughness. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Lower dose does not guarantee better resolution and roughness together. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Use an ideal Poisson model to compare relative fluctuation 1/√N for mean counts 100 and 25. Explain that this photon-statistics analogy is not an actual defect-rate prediction.

steps.failure: 常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「感度解析度粗糙度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare sensitivity-resolution-roughness and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「感度解析度粗糙度」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。

steps.title: 蝕刻耐受
steps.objective: 完成「蝕刻耐受」的因果圖，把PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.objective: 完成「光阻材料評估」的工程驗收單，把PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for deliver a resist assessment, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：光阻材料評估。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：需用相同曝光、顯影及蝕刻基準比較候選材料。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Deliver a resist assessment. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Compare candidate materials with matched exposure, development and etch baselines. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「需用相同曝光、顯影及蝕刻基準比較候選材料。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Compare candidate materials with matched exposure, development and etch baselines. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「光阻材料評估」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for deliver a resist assessment and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「光阻材料評估」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for deliver a resist assessment: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.
